title: NVIDIA Is Reportedly Eyeing Teflon, The Non-Stick Cookware Material, To Fix AI Server Signal Loss In Next-Gen NVLink Switch Boards
content: Current AI chips face a transmission bottleneck where they’re pushing 200Gbps per lane, so even the slightest interference can affect performance. Possibly realizing that there needs to be a better way to maintain optimal server throughput, NVIDIA is reportedly looking at an unlikely material to tackle one of AI hardware’s biggest headaches; PTFE, better known by the brand name Teflon and as the coating on non-stick pans.
